learning_outcomes.text: Working independently on a technical or scientific project: organising themselves responsibly to carry out a project over a period of time, respecting the stages, deadlines and objectives set.
Mobilise the knowledge acquired in school lessons to formulate, structure and solve a concrete technical or scientific problem related to the fields studied.
Collaborate effectively within a working group: demonstrate communication, active listening and mutual respect between team members.
Ensure coordination within the group: distribute tasks in a balanced way, monitor the progress of the collective work, manage the unexpected and adapt to the constraints of the group.
Prepare and lead progress meetings with the tutor: produce monitoring materials, report on the progress of the project, ask questions and integrate the tutor's feedback into the work.
Deepen disciplinary knowledge related to the project (technical, scientific or professional).
Understand the issues at stake in the context: company, sector, field of application.
Assimilate the project approach: specifications, planning, needs analysis, etc.
Write a structured report: introduction, methodology, results, analysis, conclusion, appendices.
Apply a project management method: Gantt, task management, progress monitoring.
Present results in a clear and reasoned manner: tables, graphs, explanatory diagrams.
Cite sources correctly (bibliography, standards, external data).
Work in a team and report on individual contributions.

syllabus_topics: Work meetings with the tutor of the tutored project throughout the semester.
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (1*RAP1)/1, indicating that the project report (RAP1) constitutes 100% of the grade.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
